run_dreambooth_training: run DreamBooth fine-tuning for SD3 models with configurable optimizer, scheduler, and validation
parse_training_arguments: parse CLI arguments for DreamBooth SD3 training including dataset paths, learning rates, and checkpoint settings
create_dreambooth_dataset: create a DreamBooth dataset from instance images with optional class images for prior preservation
encode_text_prompts: encode text prompts using CLIP and T5 text encoders for SD3 transformer input
run_validation_inference: run validation inference with the trained pipeline and log generated images to tensorboard or wandb
save_model_card: save a model card README with gallery images, trigger words, and usage instructions for the trained model
collate_training_batches: collate instance and class image batches with optional prior preservation concatenation
import_text_encoder_class: import the correct text encoder class (CLIP or T5) from a pretrained model configuration
